title: Small bands at Spano's and Savoca's; Jack Carey
summary: Glass says he played back rooms with three or four pieces including Walter Blue, Chris Kelly and trombonist Jack Carey.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Well what about Spanos and Savoca? How big a band would they have there?
I have three pieces, four pieces.
Well I had Walter Blue and all of them. I had Walter Blue. Sometimes I'd have Chris Kelly, Jack Carey. Jack Carey played slide.
Did he play lead when he was there much, or would he play?
Well he was a good trombone. He played the lead? Jack Carey. A good trombone player.
You couldn't have had a big band in those places?
No. Four pieces, three pieces was the most. When you had a four piece band you had a big band.
Yeah. But I know Jack could execute. Yeah. He's good. Would you have the piano players in those places?
